Based on the historical Latin parish register shown in `image_ef7363.png`, here is a complete, line-by-line transcription of both the left and right pages.

The entries follow standard 19th-century Latin baptismal formulas. Abbreviations like *Die* (Day), *filius/filia* (son/daughter), *Spons[ores]* (Sponsors/Godparents), and the recurring signature of the priest, *Joannes Quinlan v.c.* (Vice-Curate), have been transcribed as written.

---

## Left Page Transcription

### 1869

### – pr Mense Maii – [For the Month of May]

* **Die 28** | Joanna, filia Patritii Cagney et Ellenae Casey. Spons: Joanne Cagney et Margarita Keating. — *Joannes Quinlan*

### pr Mense Junii – [For the Month of June]

* **Die 7mo** | Margarita, filia Joannis Connors et Johanna Kennedy. Sponsore Johanna Morrissey. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Die 17mo** | Ellena, filia David McCann et Ellenae Falvey. Spons: Michaele McCann et Alicia Riser. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Eodem die** | [In Exposito] Thomas filius Thomae Moloney et Margaritae Heenan. Spons: Thoma Green et Maria Lynch. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Die 17** | Thomas, filius Joannis Flynn et Mariae Brehan. Spons: Martino Kearney et Ellena Flynn. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Die 29no** | Margarita, filia Michaelis Carnahan et Mariae Bowe. Spons: Patritio Kelly et Johanna Mulqueen. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*

### pr Mense Julii – [For the Month of July]

* **Die 8vo** | Joannes, filius Michaelis Morgan et Brigidae Hannan. Spons: Cornelio Carroll et Elizabeth Flawley. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Die 9no** | Ellena, filia Patritii Gleeson et Margaritae Moloney. Spons: Jeremia O'Leary et Brigida Shanahan. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Die 11mo** | Catharina, filia Joannis Cusack et Mariae Conway. Spons: Michaele Barron et Maria Blake. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Die 13mo** | In Exposito, Maria, filia illegitima Mauritii Fitzgerald de "Euriza" et Ellenae Falvey. Sponsore Maria Quin. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Die 18** | Maria, filia Timothei Hange et Johanna Carroll. Sponsore Anna Birden. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*

### pr Mense Augusti – [For the Month of August]

* **Die 12mo** | Michael, filius Jacobi Leary et Mariae Moloney. Spons: Jacobo MacCoy et Johanna Donovan. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
* **Die 21mo** | Brigida, filia Michaelis Coleman et Honoria Kiely. Spons: Mauritio Kiely et Brigida Coleman. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*

### pr Mense Septembris – [For the Month of September]

* **Die 1ma** | Joannes, filius Joannis Dunces et Mariae Callaghan. Spons: Michaele Connors et Brigida Kennedy. — *Joannes Quinlan v.c.*
